name: SambaNova Cloud Free Tier
free_limit: Free SambaCloud API access without a linked payment method: production models have 20 requests/minute, 20 requests/day and 200,000 tokens/day per model.
watch_out: Free limits are small and model-specific; requests beyond the quota are rate-limited. Linking a payment method switches to Developer tier. Preview models are evaluation-only; commercial-use terms require provider confirmation.
